title: stereospermum glandulosum
intro: Stereospermum glandulosum, commonly known as the "Kadukkai" or "Vata" in Ayurvedic medicine, is a plant species belonging to the Bignoniaceae family. It is known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which aid in the treatment of various diseases such as fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Stereospermum glandulosum include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
